verdict.rationale: Galileo documents OpenTelemetry-based tracing. The GalileoSpanProcessor stitches traces across processes using the W3C traceparent header and joins spans by trace ID. A cookbook shows instrumenting LangGraph with OpenTelemetry and OpenInference to stream traces into Galileo, so OTel-format ingestion is a first-party path alongside the proprietary SDK/@log decorator. Missing for 10: the docs never explicitly name an OTLP endpoint or protocol, there is no evidence of exporting traces out of Galileo over OTLP, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
